title: test(dogfood): pin access-security checklist clauses at the oracle's layer, slice 2
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8YSjPf3hTSLEBa52VUBikb4)_

Refs #26571 (slice 2 of about 4, items: access-security.anonymous-deny-surfaces, access-security.public-form-withdrawal-layers, access-security.activation-write-operator-gate, access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor, access-security.record-view-read-audit)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给 access-security 区接下来 5 个清单条目补上 dogfood 断言（进程内 HTTP 与进程日志，正是这些条款的 api / log oracle 层），共钉住 24 条此前只靠现场手跑的条款；扩写 2 个现有用例文件，新增 3 个隔离用例文件；5 个条目的 `automated.ref` 改写成逐条款对应、`revision` 加一、`history` 记本卡。
- 为什么改：18.2.0 Tier 1 记录 #26468 里这 5 条全是 PARTIAL，其中 3 条此前只有单元级 pin，HTTP 层完全靠手跑；钉住后每次发版不必再重跑。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试和改清单文字，不动任何产品代码；新增断言全部按现行行为写成并跑绿。没有新 CI 通道。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `platform-owner-email-anchor.dogfood.test.ts`（同一数据库按变量值逐次重启，含 `[authz]` 日志捕获）；② `activation-write-operator-gate-single.dogfood.test.ts`（两个开关入口的拒绝原句与 manage_metadata 持有者放行）；③ `record-view-read-audit.dogfood.test.ts`（默认不审计与按对象开启两次启动）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/qa/dogfood && pnpm exec vitest run test/platform-owner-email-anchor.dogfood.test.ts`（需先按 dogfood 惯例 build 依赖闭包），预期 `Tests 6 passed`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Pins at the layer each clause's oracle names: `api` is the in-process HTTP stack of `@objectstack/verify`, and `log` is the process output captured during the boot. Everything is in `packages/qa/dogfood/**`, with no product code changes. Every new assertion was written against today's behaviour and is green.

| item | clauses newly pinned | where |
|---|---|---|
| anonymous-deny-surfaces | acceptance[4], [5], negative[0] | `showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces` (shared project): the member's `GET /meta` now asserts 200 instead of `.not.toBe(401)`. On the same platform-default boot, an anonymous `GET /forms/contact-us` answers 200 and serves the `showcase_inquiry` form. After the anonymous `DELETE /automation/showcase_reassign_wizard` is refused, the admin reads the flow at its own route and gets 200 |
| public-form-withdrawal-layers | acceptance[0] (its live leg), negative[1] | `showcase-public-form-withdrawal-layers`: after the withdrawal save, the test makes no organization active and reads `GET /meta/view/showcase_inquiry.contact`, which serves `allowAnonymous: false` with the link kept; then the organization is made active again. The save message is asserted to name no organization id |
| activation-write-operator-gate | acceptance[0]–[3], negative[0]–[2] | New `activation-write-operator-gate-single` (isolated boot). A plain member is refused 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` at both doors, each with its own exact sentence. An invalid body still gets the 403, and no ledger row is written. A member holding `manage_metadata` through a set authored at runtime, with no `platform_admin` position, is admitted with 200 at both doors. Each of that member's writes lands one row whose key set has no `organization_id`. No refusal names the posture. The admin gets 200 |
| platform-owner-email-anchor | acceptance[0]–[3], acceptance[4]'s live leg, negative[0], negative[2] | New `platform-owner-email-anchor`: one database file, restarted once per value in the steps' order, with the datasource admin routes mounted the way `serve` mounts them. The variants are unset, unverified M, a non-matching address, verified M (200 plus the declared envelope), and a malformed list. The malformed list's `[authz]` line is captured once, M is refused while verified, and the admin is served. The test also asserts that `ADMIN_STANDING_NON_TABLE_INPUTS` declares the variable |
| record-view-read-audit | acceptance[0]–[4] | New `record-view-read-audit`, two boots. The stock boot runs an option-less `AuditPlugin`: there is no install line (INFO lines are present as a control), and a 200 detail read lands no `read` row after the flush. The configured boot sets `readAudit.objects` to `showcase_account` and `sys_job`. Its install line names `showcase_account` only, and `sys_job` draws the exclusion warning. One detail read lands one row with who, which and when, null values, and `created_at` set to the view instant. A list read and a read of an object that is not opted in land nothing |

Ledger: each of the five items gets a rewritten `automated.ref` that maps clauses to cases, `revision` +1, and a `history` row citing #26571. `automated.kind` stays `unit` on the three items that carried it, because this slice's claimed edit surface is `ref`, `revision` and `history`. Their refs now name the dogfood pin first.

Clauses left as they are, each with its reason in the item's `automated.ref`:

- anonymous-deny-surfaces acceptance[6]: procedural (one verdict per variant in the run record).
- public-form-withdrawal-layers acceptance[2]–[5]: no stock fixture (knownGaps), so they stay test-scored. negative[3]–[5] are procedural.
- activation-write-operator-gate acceptance[4]: its live leg needs a walled boot (knownGaps[0]), so it is scored from the pin. acceptance[5] is test-scored. negative[3] is procedural.
- platform-owner-email-anchor acceptance[5] and negative[1] are test-scored. negative[3] is out of scope.
- record-view-read-audit acceptance[5] is test-scored. negative[0] needs a broken ledger. negative[1] is the unit pin's no-principal skip. negative[2] is a cross-reference.

## Tests

Head `f3aa3510`, the five touched files, under `os-verify-lock`: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 103 passed (103)` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0. The full dogfood battery is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- platform-owner-email-anchor: the variants restart one deployment on one database, because the item's steps restart one deployment too. Measured on this head, a fresh database booted with a well-formed `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` promotes only the declared owner (`bootstrap-platform-admin.ts`, the declared-owner branch). The seeded admin then answers 403 on `GET /datasources`, so the admin contrast in acceptance[2] exists only on a deployment first booted unset. The pin follows the steps, and the ref records why.
- M's verification is a system-context engine update of `email_verified`. This is the doorway the item's knownGaps names, because no HTTP door verifies a second account. Before the malformed variant runs, the pin asserts that M holds no `admin_full_access` grant, so M's refusal there comes from the malformed entry alone.
- record-view-read-audit: the configured half uses `bootShowcase`'s `extraPlugins` instead of the knownGaps scratch-copy recipe. It is the same constructor call the docs snippet puts in an app's `plugins` array, and the measured install line is the one the item quotes.

## Verification

Local gate subset on head `f3aa3510` (origin/main `c8583f80` contained): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 55 families. All 55 ran and exited 0, and `--ran` reconciles `55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Repository-wide scans (`pnpm lint`, the full dogfood battery) are CI's.

`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`.

Changeset: none. `@objectstack/dogfood` is private and `docs/qa/**` ships in no package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
